name: manage_reminders
description: Create, list, update, or delete reminders. When a reminder fires, the user's message is replayed to the AI assistant, which handles it like a normal request (calling skills, using voice, etc. as needed).

time.description: For 'create' (required) or 'update': ISO 8601 datetime for when the reminder fires (e.g. 2026-04-09T09:00:00Z).

message.description: For 'create' (required) or 'update': the complete instruction to replay at the scheduled time. Include everything — language, voice, topic, format. E.g. '查看今天的香港头条新闻，用语音播报'

repeat.description: Recurrence pattern. Omit for one-time reminders.

reminder_id.description: Required for 'update' and 'delete'. Obtain by calling 'list' first.
